articles.headline: Nvidia Vera To Use SK Hynix Memory as Stock Surges 220% in 2026
articles.summary: Nvidia has selected SK Hynix as the memory chip supplier for its Vera chip, which will see it compete with AMD and Intel
articles._summary: Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA ) , the biggest company globally, has selected South Korea's SK Hynix to be the memory supplier for its new Vera chip, a move that may supercharge the latter's stock. SK Hynix stock has jumped by 220% this year and by 817% in the last 12 months, making it one of the best gainers globally. Its 1,500% surge in the last five years has helped to transform it into a $1 trillion company. SK Hynix stock five-year performance | Source: TradingView

articles.author: Benzinga Newsdesk
articles.headline: Viral DRAM ETF Stock Just Crashed By 20%, Highlighting Key Risk
articles.summary: The viral DRAM ETF stock has just crashed by 20% from its highest point this year, highlighting its diversification risk to investors.
articles._summary: The viral Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM) has been in the spotlight since going public in April this year. Its stock jumped from $28 to $70 as its constituent companies surged. This growth, together with the inflows, pushed its total assets to over $16 billion. DRAM stock ended last week at $55.80, down by over 20% from its highest point on record as investors dumped technology stocks.
articles._zh_headline: Viral DRAM ETF 股票暴跌 20%，凸显关键风险
articles._zh_summary: 自今年 4 月上市以来，备受关注的 Roundhill Memory ETF（CBOE：DRAM）一直备受关注。随着其成分公司股价飙升，其股价从 28 美元跃升至 70 美元。这一增长加上资金流入，使其总资产超过 160 亿美元。由于投资者抛售科技股，DRAM 股价上周收于 55.80 美元，较历史最高点下跌逾 20%。

articles.author: Benzinga Newsdesk
articles.headline: Bitcoin Price Rally May Be a Dead Cat Bounce as Death Cross Nears and ETF Outflows
articles.summary: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) price is attempting to rebound after falling to a 2024-year low on Saturday. It jumped to $62,230, up modestly from the weekend low of $59,093.
articles._summary: BTC price has been in a strong sell-off in the past few weeks as Wall Street investors continued dumping its ETFs. Data shows that these funds have shed over $5.4 billion in the last four weeks. They now have a cumulative total net inflow of $53.94 billion and hold $75 billion in assets. At Bitcoin's peak, these funds held over $130 billion in assets. There is also a likelihood that some investors have dumped their ETF holdings in anticipation of the upcoming SpaceX IPO .
articles._zh_headline: 随着死亡交叉临近和 ETF 流出，比特币价格上涨可能是死猫反弹
articles._zh_summary: 过去几周，随着华尔街投资者继续抛售 ETF，比特币价格出现大幅抛售。数据显示，这些基金在过去四个星期内损失了超过 54 亿美元。他们目前累计净流入总额为539.4亿美元，持有资产750亿美元。在比特币巅峰时期，这些基金持有超过 1300 亿美元的资产。一些投资者也有可能因预期 SpaceX 即将上市而抛售其持有的 ETF。
